text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I flipped microbatch_interval 2ms -> 4ms on rtx-cluster while testing int8 kernels and saw a 2–3% p99 latency spike.
alex: Can you paste the profiler summary and which kernel was selected?
maria: Summary below (short):
```
model: resi-6B
chosen_kernel: attn_int8_v2
fallback_kernel: attn_fp16
microbatch_interval_ms: 4
coalesce_delay_us: 500
kv_hit_rate: 84.2% -> baseline 90.1%
p95_latency_ms: 42.7
p99_latency_ms: 78.3 (was 76.5)
``` 
jamal: kv_hit_rate drop stands out. Could be our coalesce window increasing prefix divergence so KV prefetch misses. Also check queue-policy: token_budget_target might be too low causing earlier flushes.
kevin: Can you run with kernel pinned to attn_int8_v1 and with jitter increased? My hunch: jitter smoothing prevents pathological alignment that causes KV cold-starts.
perf-bot: CI perf run 3955: kernel attn_int8_v2 showed -2.7% p99 vs baseline when microbatch_interval=2ms; with 4ms we see +3.1%.
maria: Plan: run two canaries — (A) pin kernel to attn_int8_v1 + token_budget_target=1024 + jitter_ms=1.5; (B) keep v2 but reduce microbatch_interval_ms=3 and coalesce_jitter_ms=0.8. Will attach trace id when done.
alex: add --trace / link to flame graphs. Also include kv priming metric (prefetch_hits) in the profiler output.
jamal: also sanity-check kernel-selection heuristic: maybe selection picks v2 for sequences >512 but our seq distro changed. If so, tweak kernel scoring to favor kv-friendly kernels when kv_hit_rate < 85%.
maria: Will run canaries now. Triage follow-up in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: thx — if you see repro, set KERNEL_MATCH_SCORE_BIAS=-0.2 to prefer fp16 as fallback temporarily.
perf-bot: note: added microbatch-smoke job to nightly with parameters microbatch_interval_ms [2,3,4], coalesce_jitter_ms [0.5,1.0,1.5].
